tags.name: myapp-button
tags.description:
AuroButton is a custom element that provides a styled, accessible button with support for various states and form association.
It is designed to be flexible, supporting loading states, icon slots, and integration with HTML5 forms.
---


### **Methods:**
 - **register(name: _string_)** - This will register this element with the browser.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Defines whether the button will be on lighter or darker backgrounds.

attributes.name: autofocus
attributes.description: This Boolean attribute lets you specify that the button should have input focus when the page loads, unless overridden by the user.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: If set to true, button will become disabled and not allow for interactions.

attributes.name: fluid
attributes.description: Alters the shape of the button to be full width of its parent container.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: Defines the layout of an element.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: If set to true button text will be replaced with `auro-loader` and become disabled.

attributes.name: loadingText
attributes.description: DEPRECATED - Use `slot="ariaLabel.loading"` instead.

attributes.name: ondark
attributes.description: DEPRECATED - use `appearance` attribute.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Defines the shape of an element.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Defines the size of an element.

attributes.name: static
attributes.description: If true, the button will be static and not respond to user interactions.

attributes.name: tabindex
attributes.description:
Populates `tabindex` to define the focusable sequence in keyboard navigation.
Must be used with "." to ensure the host element does not retain a reference to the `tabindex` attribute.
Example: `<auro-button .tabindex="${this.disabled ? '-1' : '0'}"></auro-button>`.

attributes.name: tIndex
attributes.description: Populates `tabindex` to define the focusable sequence in keyboard navigation.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Sets title attribute. The information is most often shown as a tooltip text when the mouse moves over the element.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Defines the value associated with the button which is submitted with the form data.

tags.name: legacy-input
tags.description:
The `auro-input` element provides users a way to enter data into a text field.
---


### **Events:**
 - **auroInput-validityChange**
- **input** - Event fires when the value of an `auro-input` has been changed.
- **auroFormElement-validated** - Notifies that the `validity` and `errorMessage` value has changed.

### **Methods:**
 - **register(name: _string_)** - This will register this element with the browser.
- **focus(): _void_** - Function to set element focus.
- **validate(force: _boolean_)** - Validates value.
- **reset(): _void_** - Resets component to initial state, including resetting the touched state and validity.
- **clear()** - Clears the input value.

### **Slots:**
 - **ariaLabel.clear** - Sets aria-label on clear button for screen reader to read
- **ariaLabel.password.show** - Sets aria-label on password button to toggle on showing password
- **ariaLabel.password.hide** - Sets aria-label on password button to toggle off showing password
- **helpText** - Sets the help text displayed below the input.
- **label** - Sets the label text for the input.
- **optionalLabel** - Allows overriding the optional display text "(optional)", which appears next to the label.
- **displayValue** - Allows custom HTML content to display in place of the value when the input is not focused.

### **CSS Parts:**
 - **wrapper** - Use for customizing the style of the root element
- **label** - Use for customizing the style of the label element
- **helpText** - Use for customizing the style of the helpText element
- **input** - Use for customizing the style of the input element
- **accentIcon** - Use for customizing the style of the accentIcon element (e.g. credit card icon, calendar icon)
- **iconContainer** - Use for customizing the style of the iconContainer (e.g. X icon for clearing input value)
- **accent-left** - Use for customizing the style of the left accent element (e.g. padding, margin)
- **accent-right** - Use for customizing the style of the right accent element (e.g. padding, margin)
- **displayValue** - Use for customizing the style of the displayValue element
- **inputHelpText** - Use for customizing the style of the input help text wrapper

attributes.name: a11yRole
attributes.description: The value for the role attribute.

attributes.name: a11yControls
attributes.description: The value for the aria-controls attribute.

attributes.name: a11yExpanded
attributes.description: The value for the aria-expanded attribute.

attributes.name: a11yActivedescendant
attributes.description:
The value for the aria-activedescendant attribute.
Points to the ID of the currently active/highlighted option in a listbox.

attributes.name: activeLabel
attributes.description:
If set, the label will remain fixed in the active position.
Only applies to the classic/default layout; the emphasized and snowflake
layouts always render the label inside the field, so this has no effect there.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Defines whether the component will be on lighter or darker backgrounds.

attributes.name: autocapitalize
attributes.description: An enumerated attribute that controls whether and how text input is automatically capitalized as it is entered/edited by the user. [off/none, on/sentences, words, characters].

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: An enumerated attribute that defines what the user agent can suggest for autofill. At this time, only `autocomplete="off"` is supported.

attributes.name: autocorrect
attributes.description: When set to `off`, stops iOS from auto-correcting words when typed into a text box.

attributes.name: customValidityTypeEmail
attributes.description: Custom help text message for email type validity.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: If set, disables the input.

attributes.name: dvInputOnly
attributes.description: If defined, the display value slot content will only mask the HTML5 input element. The input's label will not be masked.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: When defined, sets persistent validity to `customError` and sets `setCustomValidity` = attribute value.

attributes.name: errorMessage
attributes.description: Contains the help text message for the current validity error.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description:
Overrides LitElement's generated accessor so we can track whether the
consumer explicitly set `format`. Locale-derived updates use
`_setFormatFromLocale` instead, which skips this flag.

attributes.name: hideLabelVisually
attributes.description: If set, the label will be hidden visually but still accessible to assistive technologies.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: If set, will render an icon inside the input to the left of the value. Support is limited to auro-input instances with credit card format.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: The id global attribute defines an identifier (ID) which must be unique in the whole document.

attributes.name: inputmode
attributes.description: Exposes inputmode attribute for input.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.description: Defines the language of an element.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description:
Defines the locale of an element.
Used for locale-specific formatting, such as date formats.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: The maximum value allowed. This only applies for inputs with a type of `number` and ISO format.

attributes.name: maxLength
attributes.description:
The maximum number of characters the user can enter into the text input. This must be an integer value `0` or higher.
**Note**: This attribute is not intended to be used with a `type` or `format` that already has a defined length, such as credit-cards, dates or phone numbers.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: The minimum value allowed. This only applies for inputs with a type of `number` and ISO date format.

attributes.name: minLength
attributes.description: The minimum number of characters the user can enter into the text input. This must be a non-negative integer value smaller than or equal to the value specified by `maxlength`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Populates the `name` attribute on the input.

attributes.name: nested
attributes.description:
Sets styles for nested operation - removes borders, hides help + error text, and
hides accents.

attributes.name: noValidate
attributes.description: If set, disables auto-validation on blur.

attributes.name: onDark
attributes.description: DEPRECATED - use `appearance="inverse"` instead.

attributes.name: pattern
attributes.description: Specifies a regular expression the form control's value should match.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Define custom placeholder text.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Makes the input read-only, but can be set programmatically.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Populates the `required` attribute on the input. Used for client-side validation.

attributes.name: setCustomValidity
attributes.description: Sets a custom help text message to display for all validityStates.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityBadInput
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `badInput`.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityCustomError
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `customError`.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityForType
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display for the declared element `type` and type validity fails.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityPatternMismatch
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `patternMismatch`.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityRangeOverflow
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `rangeOverflow`.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityRangeUnderflow
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `rangeUnderflow`.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityTooLong
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `tooLong`.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityTooShort
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `tooShort`.

attributes.name: setCustomValidityValueMissing
attributes.description: Custom help text message to display when validity = `valueMissing`.

attributes.name: simple
attributes.description: Simple makes the input render without a border.

attributes.name: spellcheck
attributes.description: An enumerated attribute defines whether the element may be checked for spelling errors. [true, false]. When set to `false` the attribute `autocorrect` is set to `off` and `autocapitalize` is set to `none`.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Populates the `type` attribute on the input.

attributes.name: validateOnInput
attributes.description: Sets validation mode to re-eval with each input.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Specifies the `validityState` this element is in.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description:
Populates the `value` attribute on the input. Can also be read to retrieve the current value of the input.
For `date` type inputs using a full date format (year/month/day), the `value` should be ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). Partial date formats use the display format.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: Defines the language of an element.
